Drag your armies: press and hold your army’s marker on the map (a moment, until the line appears) and, without lifting, take it to the destination province. A label shows the province’s name; when you release, it gets the same order as «🎯 Move».\n
  • Cancel: release over the same province or outside the map.
  • Move the map: if you drag right away (without holding), the map scrolls as usual; with two fingers you zoom.
    • \n
  • Sound and effects: in Settings you choose the volume (or off), music and particles (coins, confetti, battle sparks).

Particle effects (coins, confetti, sparks) are a cheap way to give a game “juice”: the player feels their actions have weight. They are drawn on a separate canvas and only while there is something to show, to save battery.

Coins when a lot of money comes in at once, confetti and stars for achievements, promotions and victories, and sparks with smoke in the battles you can see on the map. In automatic they turn off on slow devices.
All sounds and music are generated on the spot with oscillators and filtered noise (synthesis), like on old consoles: there are no audio files to download.
Choose the volume (Low, Medium or High) or turn it off, and the music separately. On iPhone the sound starts after your first tap, because Safari does not let a page play sound before that.
